name: Shared Cleanup — Finish Group
intent: Shared room-level cleanup for a finish_group_assignment pass: floor protection teardown + wall masking removal (spray only). Fires ONCE per group. Per-substrate final inspect + touchup live on each member's own cleanup module (they read per-substrate LF keys, not TRIM_TOTAL).
doctrine: Room-level teardown only — FLOOR_PERIMETER + WALL_ADJACENT keys are room-level and shared across all grouped substrates. Per-substrate cleanup modules (MOD_CLEANUP_*_PAINT) carry their own FINAL_INSPECT + TOUCHUP_FINAL tasks reading their own LF keys; these fire ungated per group member so every substrate gets its own acceptance pass.
